test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following books is an autobiography of the professional boxer Mike Tyson?

options.text: Straight From the Heart: An Autobiography

solution:
The correct answer is **__Undisputed Truth: My Autobiography.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Tyson is considered to be one of the greatest heavyweight boxers of all time.
 
• The **Autobiography of Mike Tyson **is **Undisputed Truth: My autobiography.**
